name: Wizard
description: A wizard may use spells from their known list of spells. A wizard may only use one spell per turn. They may not wear armour or use shields.

name: Priest
description: A Priest may use prayers from their known list of prayers. A Priest may only use one prayer per turn. They may wear armour and use shields.

name: Weapons/Armour (Gnoblar)
description: Dagger and sharp stuff (treat as thrown weapon with S2, range 8" and fire twice)

name: Largely Insignificant (Gnoblar)
description: Gnoblars count towards the number of warriors in a warband but are not considered for Rout tests - neither for determining the initial warband size nor as lost models.

name: Bicker (Gnoblar)
description: Roll a D6 at the beginning of the turn for each Gnoblar within 2" of another Gnoblar and not engaged in close combat. On a result of 1 the Gnoblar starts to bicker, insult and/or bully the other Gnoblar and may do nothing else this turn.

name: Animal
description: Animals never gain experience

name: Battle Schooled
description:
The mount has been specially trained to fight on a battlefield. The rider may re-roll any failed loss of control tests. Only one re-roll is allowed per test.

Note

It is suggested that Chaos steeds should be available to all Chaos warbands, not just those that existed when these rules were originally published.

name: Scaly (Cold One)
description: Cold ones give an additional +1 armour save bonus (making +2 total).

name: Poisoned Attack (Giant Spider)
description: Giant Spider attacks are poisoned - attacks are considered as Strength 4, but this will not modify any armour saves.

name: Wall Walk (Giant Spider)
description:
Giant Spiders (and their riders) may walk up and down walls without making Initiative tests. They may only jump up to 2" across or down, but this does count as a diving charge. When a spider jumps, its rider must make an Initiative test; if this test is failed, something has gone wrong - roll on the Whoa Boy! Table. Note even if the rider has the Running Dismount skill, the maximum diving charge is only 2".

Note

Giant Spiders cannot be used in a warband that already contains Giant Wolves.

name: Slow (Mule)
description: Mules are not the fastest of mounts and only bolt 2D6".

name: Stubborn (Mule)
description: If a warrior is riding a mule, or is in base contact with a mule, he must make a Leadership test each round or the mule will refuse to move.

name: Ornery (Mule)
description: With no leader or rider, a mule will wander in a random direction. Should any close combat occur within 6", it will automatically bolt directly away from the combat.

name: Non-combatant (Mule)
description: Mules will not fight in combat and may not be used to charge into combat - they will simply refuse to move. If an enemy warrior charges a ridden mule, immediately roll on the Whoa Boy! Table. If an unridden mule is charged, it will bolt directly away from the charger.

name: May Not Run (Nightmare)
description: As an undead creature, a Nightmare may not run, but may charge as normal.

name: Immune to Psychology (Nightmare)
description: As an Undead creature, Nightmares are immune to psychology, never have to make Leadership tests, and will always stand still if left leaderless. However, if the rider suffers a wound, he must roll on the Whoa Boy! Table as normal.

name: Rarity (Rhinox)
description: A Hero searching for a Rhinox adds +1 to his rarity roll for each point of Strength he has. If a Rhinox was found the Hero must take a Strength test. If the test is failed he was wounded by the Rhinox while he tried to capture and tame it. Roll once on the Serious Injury table for him immediately.

name: Bad Tempered (Rhinox)
description: Even Rhinoxen that have been broken by their riders have a temper shorter than a pygmy's thumb. If there is an enemy model that is an eligible target for the Rhinox rider to charge during the Declare Charges part of the Movement phase, it must immediately pass a Leadership test or declare a charge  if there is a choice of models to charge, then the controlling player may choose freely between them.

name: Thunderous Charge (Rhinox)
description: Even a single Rhinox rider in full charge is a terrifying sight, the ground itself trembling as the cavebeast thunders into the ranks of their foe. On any turn when a Rhinox rider charges more than 7", he causes D3 impact hits at the basic strength of the Rhinox.

name: Save (Temple Dog)
description: Because of their stone-like skin, Temple Dogs have an Armour save of 5+ that is not modified by the strength of attacks against it (or by other save modifiers).

name: Ferocious Charge (Temple Dog)
description: Temple Dogs attack with +1 Strength when charging, due to their bulk.

name: Ferocious Charge (War Boar)
description: Orc war boars attack with +2S when charging, due to their bulk. Note that this applies only to the boar, not the rider.

name: Magical attacks (Temple Dog)
description: Magical attacks: All attacks from a Temple Dog are considered to be magical in the same way as the attacks of Daemons.

name: Thick Skinned (War Boar)
description: The thick skin and matted fur of the boar makes him very hard to wound. Boars confer an additional + 1 bonus to the rider's armour save (making +2 total).

name: Wizard's Familiar (Sorcerous Society)
description: A wizard may have only one familiar. It is equipment, but alive: taken out of action, it rolls for injury as a henchman. It counts towards neither the warband's size nor its Rout tests. If it dies or leaves, the wizard may search for another by the rarity rules.

name: Small Target (Familiar)
description: Models shooting at a familiar have -1 BS.

name: Loyal (Dog Familiar)
description: Within 6" of its wizard the Dog is immune to fear.

name: Sniff (Dog Familiar)
description: The warband may roll one more exploration dice, and may use it in place of one rolled for a surviving Hero.

name: Go for the Eyes! (Cat Familiar)
description: If both its attacks wound in one round, the enemy is blinded and can't fight back until his next turn. If only one wounds, he has -1 WS and -1 BS until the start of his next turn.

name: Fly (Raven Familiar)
description: The Raven may fly up to 12" anywhere on the table.

name: I see you! (Raven Familiar)
description: Spells may be cast on models within range of either the wizard or the Raven: a 12" spell reaches models within 12" of either.

name: Poison (Viper Familiar)
description: A 6 to hit wounds automatically, with no armour save. Any other hit on a target that poison affects is at S4; on one immune to poison, at S2.

name: Woodland Dwelling (Bear)
description: The model suffers no movement penalty for moving through wooded areas.

name: Weapons/Armour (Bestigor)
description: Roll a D6 for the model's weapons and armour: 1-2 a sword and a dagger; 3-5 a halberd, a dagger and light armour; 6 a double-handed axe and heavy armour.

name: Immune to Psychology (Beasts of the East)
description: The model is immune to psychology, never leaves combat and automatically passes every Leadership-based test it must take.

name: Daemonic Aura (Beasts of the East)
description: The model has a natural 5+ armour save, which magic weapons and spells negate. Its attacks count as magical.

name: Magical Resistance (Bloodletter)
description: On a D6 roll of 4+ the model ignores a magical effect: a spell, a magic weapon and the like, but not another daemon's attacks.

name: Mark of Chaos (Champion of Chaos)
description: Roll a D6 for the model's mark: 1-2 the Mark of Chaos Undivided, 3 the Mark of Tchar, 4 the Mark of Arkhar, 5 the Mark of Onogal, 6 the Mark of Shornaal. Each works as the Marauders of Chaos warband list gives it to the leader.

name: Scaly Skin (Chaos Dragon)
description: The model's scales give it a 3+ armour save.

name: Fly (Beasts of the East)
description: The model triples its Movement when running and ignores terrain when moving.

name: Breath Weapons (Chaos Dragon)
description: Every turn the model uses both of its breath weapons, each with the Small Flame Template (Mordheim Annual 2002, p34): one head breathes fire at Strength 4, the other corrosive gas at Strength 2 with a -3 save modifier.

name: Gigantic Monster (Beasts of the East)
description: Any model may shoot at the model with +2 to hit, even when it isn't the closest target. Each knocked down result it suffers instead takes 1 Attack from it until its next Recovery phase, several results taking one each. Whatever the scenario, a Hero or Henchman gains +1 Experience for each wound he inflicts on it.

name: Regeneration (Chaos Troll)
description: Whenever an enemy wounds the model, roll a D6: on a 4+ the wound is ignored. A wound caused by fire or fire-based magic can't be ignored this way.

name: Vomit Attack (Chaos Troll)
description: Instead of its normal attacks, the model may make a single attack against one opponent in hand-to-hand combat, which hits automatically at Strength 5 and ignores armour saves.

name: Mark of Chaos (Daemon Prince)
description: Roll a D6 for the model's mark: 1 the Mark of Tchar, 2-3 the Mark of Arkhar, 4 the Mark of Onogal, 5-6 the Mark of Shornaal.

name: Aura of Slaanesh (Daemonette)
description: Each model in hand-to-hand combat with the model has -1 Leadership, to a minimum of 2.

name: Scaly Skin (Dragon Ogre)
description: The model's scales give it a natural 5+ save.

name: Storm Rage (Dragon Ogre)
description: The model is immune to every attack and spell based on lightning (such as the Lizardmen's Chotec's Wrath), and becomes subject to frenzy when one hits it.

name: Attacks (Giant)
description: Roll a D6 for the attack the model makes: 1-2 Grab-it!: the nearest model must pass an Initiative test, or the Giant bites his head off and the warrior is removed from his warband's roster; 3-6 Tree Strike: a single attack that causes D6 wounds if it hits.

name: Fire of Tzeentch (Horror)
description: In its shooting phase roll 2D6: on a 6+ the nearest model within 12" is hit at Strength 1. While the model is in hand-to-hand combat, the hit goes to one opponent in base contact, picked at random.

name: Loss of Heads (Hydra)
description: The model has as many Attacks as it has Wounds left.

name: Regeneration (Hydra)
description: Whenever an enemy wounds the model, roll a D6: on a 4+ the wound is ignored.

name: Weapons/Armour (Monkey Warrior)
description: The model fights unarmed or with makeshift weapons such as branches or stones, with no penalty for either.

name: Lightning Speed (Monkey Warrior)
description: The model triples its Movement when running or charging, and may run even with enemy models within 8".

name: May Not Run (Terracotta Soldier)
description: The model may not run, nor double its Movement when charging.

name: Stone Skin (Terracotta Soldier)
description: The model has a 5+ armour save, which neither an attack's Strength nor any other save modifier changes.

name: Weakness (Terracotta Soldier)
description: After each turn of hand-to-hand combat with the model, a Hero who can gain experience and wounded it in that turn's hand-to-hand combat step may take a Leadership test: if he passes, he has found a weakness, and the model rolls on the Injury table at once.

name: Ferocious Charge (Wild Boar)
description: The model has +1 Strength when it charges.

name: Thick Skin (Wild Boar)
description: The model has a 6+ armour save.

name: Keen Senses (Ymir)
description: The model spots hidden enemies from twice its Initiative in inches.

name: Rover (Ymir)
description: The model ignores every penalty for difficult terrain and harsh weather.

name: Thick Fur (Ymir)
description: The model has a 5+ armour save.

name: Trained (Mutiny in Marienburg)
description: A trained animal is subject to the rules for stupidity. It need not take those tests while its handler is within 6", and may use his Leadership within 6" of him; it never uses the warband leader's Leadership. It may not be used in a battle its handler misses, and a warband with no handler must keep it caged until it hires one. Its handler must be a Beastmaster or have the animal's own handling skill.

name: Great Beast (Mutiny in Marienburg)
description: The beast can only be used in multi-player games. Mighty blows rock it rather than fell it: each knocked down result takes 1 Attack from it until it recovers in the Recovery phase of its next turn, several results taking one each, and at 0 Attacks or fewer it may not attack until it recovers.

name: Familiar (Mutiny in Marienburg)
description: A familiar may be included with any wizard model, or kept on a base of its own and ignored for game purposes. A wizard with a familiar may re-roll one failed roll to cast a spell each turn, and must accept the re-roll. A wizard hired as a Hired Sword may claim one.

name: Aquatic (Mutiny in Marienburg)
description: The creature may move through water terrain without penalty.

name: Gigantic Monster (Mutiny in Marienburg)
description: Huge Beast: any model may shoot at it with +2 to hit, even when it is not the closest target. Skull of Iron: it treats a stunned result as knocked down instead. Staggered, but not down: each knocked down result takes 1 Attack from it until it recovers in the Recovery phase of its next turn, several results taking one each. +1 for wounding: whatever the scenario, a Hero or Henchman earns +1 Experience for each wound he inflicts on it. Great Beast: it can only be used in multi-player games.

name: Superheated Breath (Geckamand)
description: Made in the shooting phase; the Geckamand may move and fire, and the target must be in line of sight. Place the small teardrop template with its narrow end at the Geckamand's mouth and its wide end towards the target, roll an artillery dice and move the template that many inches towards the target. Every model under the template takes a Strength 3 hit, and the gas ignores normal armour saves. On a Misfire the handler got in the way and the lizard attacks him this turn instead.

name: Tunnel Rat (Geckamand)
description: Any characteristic test taken for a scenario set in the sewers or elsewhere underground may be re-rolled.

name: Night Vision (Geckamand)
description: The Geckamand spots hidden enemies from twice its Initiative value in inches away.

name: Hot Blooded (Geckamand)
description: The Geckamand is immune to damage from fire and heat-based attacks.

name: Scaly Skin (Geckamand)
description: The Geckamand has a 6+ armour save, which is not modified by the Strength of attacks against it or by any other save modifier.

name: Bite Attack (Geckamand)
description: The Geckamand has a bite attack that wounds using its own Strength. The bite always strikes last, whoever charged and whatever weapon is used, and even after double-handed weapons.

name: Camouflage (Geckamand)
description: Missile attacks against the Geckamand suffer -1 to hit.

name: Tongue! (Geckamand)
description: The Geckamand may unfurl its tongue up to 3", rolling to hit with its Ballistic Skill. A hit traps the target, which can do nothing but try to escape and against which no further attacks may be made until the tongue is retracted. The trapped model must pass a Strength test to wriggle free, with +1 to the test for a large model; if it succeeds, or the Geckamand lets go, it counts as knocked down. A knocked down mount throws its rider (see 3-4 on the Whoa Boy! chart).

name: Cutting Edge (Cathayan Temple Rooster)
description: The rooster's attacks have an extra -1 armour save modifier.

name: Strike First (Cathayan Temple Rooster)
description: The rooster strikes first in the first round of a hand-to-hand combat.

name: Cock-a-doodle! (Cathayan Temple Rooster)
description: Every enemy in base contact with the rooster is at -2 to hit in their first round of combat unless they pass a Leadership test.

name: Cat Friend (Polecat)
description: A polecat cannot attack or be attacked, but needs a model because it may intercept a charge made against its Hero. The charging model counts as having entered close combat with the polecat; the charge is completed as normal, no combat follows, and on the charger's next turn it no longer counts as being in hand-to-hand combat. The polecat must always be within 3" of the Hero. If the Hero is taken out of action it runs away and returns after the battle; if he is slain it is lost with him like any other equipment.

name: Snake Charming (Snake)
description: A snake may only be used by a Hero with a Snake Charmer's Flute or the special skill Snake Charmer.

name: Venomous (Snake)
description: A snake's attacks count as attacking with Black Lotus.

name: Provisions (Sacrificial Goat/Sheep)
description: The animal is provisions, used once after a battle. When the warband sells Treasures it counts as one size lower (a warband of 10-12 counts as 7-9), but never lower than 1-3 models.

name: Sacrifice (Sacrificial Goat/Sheep)
description: If the warband includes a wizard, the animal may be sacrificed in the recovery phase to add +1 to the result of any spell he casts in the next shooting phase. The wizard may not move in the turn of the sacrifice.

name: Dung (Fighting Monkey)
description: A monkey attempting a dung throw may not charge. Roll a D6: on a 3+ it finds something malleable, on a 1-2 nothing comes to hand. A monkey holding a dung projectile may not improvise another, and the projectile is lost once thrown. It is thrown as a missile at range 6" and Strength as user -1, as a thrown weapon.

name: Beast of Burden (Camel)
description: A camel can carry up to two human-sized warriors or smaller, or the equivalent in cargo.

name: Unsettling (Camel)
description: A camel causes fear in every kind of equine animal.

name: Bear Hug (Bear)
description: If the bear hits the same enemy with both of its attacks in a round of combat, the player may make a single Bear Hug attack instead of resolving them normally. Each player rolls a D6 and adds his model's Strength. If the bear's total is higher, or the totals are equal, the enemy takes one automatic wound with no armour save allowed; if the enemy's total is higher he has broken the hold and takes no damage.

name: Fiercely Loyal (Bear)
description: As long as his bear is not taken out of action during a game, a Hero ignores the Serious Injury results Sold to the Pits, Robbed and Captured, and the matching results of a setting's own injury table: treat them as Full Recovery instead.

name: Scaly Skin (Dragon Turtle)
description: The Dragon Turtle has a 5+ armour save, which is not modified by the Strength of attacks against it or by any other save modifier.

name: Hard Shell (Dragon Turtle)
description: The Dragon Turtle is immune to being stunned: treat a stunned result from the Injury chart as knocked down.

name: Massive Beak (Dragon Turtle)
description: One of the Dragon Turtle's attacks is a bite from its beak. A model damaged by it suffers a further -1 to its armour save, for -3 in all.

name: Breathe Steam (Dragon Turtle)
description: Made in the shooting phase. Place the small teardrop template with its narrow end at the turtle's mouth; every model under it is hit on a roll of 4+ and takes a Strength 4 hit. Normal armour saves apply.

name: Gullet (Pelican)
description: At the end of the movement phase a pelican may fetch one piece of cargo within 12" of its Hero, except a chest or anything that takes more than one model to lift: move that cargo marker next to the Hero.

name: Ill Omen (Raven)
description: Once per battle the raven may make an enemy model within line of sight of its Hero fail a roll. That roll may be re-rolled with a re-roll.

name: Ghastly (Lizard-Hawk)
description: At the start of the shooting phase the Hero's player may name an enemy warrior. That model is at -1 to hit in close combat and has -1 on any dice roll it makes in the player's next shooting phase. The lizard-hawk never harries the same warrior two turns running unless it is sent to spy.

name: Spy (Lizard-Hawk)
description: The player may name a model that was hidden. From then on that model cannot remain hidden, and the lizard-hawk harries it until the battle ends.

name: Bird Friend (Owl)
description: At the start of the shooting phase the Hero's player may name a warrior, who may re-roll any failed rolls to hit with missiles, including thrown items and magic missiles. The owl never settles on the same warrior two turns running.

name: Falconry (Falcon/Hawk)
description: A hunting bird may only be used by a Hero with the animal handling skill Falconer. Its range is 24"; shooting rolls to hit with the warrior's Ballistic Skill, and the bird flies back to him after it attacks. In close combat it strikes first with a single attack using the warrior's Weapon Skill, and each hit inflicts a Strength 3 hit. A warrior using a hunting bird without a falconry glove rolls on the Serious Injury chart in the post-battle sequence. Unless stated otherwise a falconer may keep only one hunting bird.

name: Bird Companion (Mutiny in Marienburg)
description: If the Hero is taken out of action the bird flies away and returns after the battle. Birds cannot be attacked or slain, but if the Hero is slain the bird is lost with him like any other equipment.

name: Fly (Wyvern)
description: The Wyvern may move three times its Movement in any direction.

name: Save (Wyvern)
description: The Wyvern has a 5+ armour save, which is not modified by the Strength of attacks against it or by any other save modifier.

name: Envenomed Tail (Wyvern)
description: Before its normal attacks in close combat the Wyvern makes a tail strike. Roll a D6: every enemy in base contact that it may attack in the close combat phase and whose Initiative is lower than the score is automatically hit and takes a Strength 4 hit. A model whose Initiative equals or beats the score has dodged the tail.
